dict.string: FocusDesk 96 shows your Apple Calendar events in its own calendar. If you turn on writing, it also adds your FocusDesk events and assignments to a calendar called FocusDesk, and changes only that calendar.

FocusDesk 96 shows your Apple Calendar events in its own calendar. If you turn on writing, it also adds your FocusDesk events and assignments to a calendar called FocusDesk, and changes only that calendar.
FocusDesk 96 shows your Apple Reminders in its Tasks. If you turn on writing, it also adds your reminders and tasks to a Reminders list called FocusDesk, and changes only that list.
